svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · PicPlace status · uploading · phone
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlaceStatusCard (App/PicPlace/PicPlaceViews.swift) over the upload jobs of App/PicPlace/PicPlaceUploadJobs.swift (2026-09-24, code first, signed off from the Mac screenshots the same day): a person's Upload of a project's originals is a JOB that can pause and wait. While its run is going the header is the syncing state with **Pause** where every other sync says Cancel (actionButton), and the Originals/Blends lines hide. While it waits, ONE line replaces them (heavyLines → uploadJobLine): Upload paused (Cancel · Resume), Waiting for Wi-Fi (Cancel · Use mobile data — for this upload only, never the setting), Upload interrupted (Cancel · Resume; it also goes again on its own), Upload stopped (the reason first; Cancel · Try again), and Upload waiting (nothing held; the session or the launch holds it — not drawn: the paused line with its words). The two buttons sit beside the text when the detail fits on one line (jobLineRow's ViewThatFits — the Mac, the paused line on a phone) and on a line of their own, trailing, under it when not (a phone's waiting, interrupted and stopped lines — found drawing these: beside a wrapped detail, Use mobile data broke over two lines). Cancel is secondary grey, the first button accent, both 12.8pt semibold (heavyAction size 16 × 0.8), 14.4pt apart. The header keeps the project's own state — synced here, with auto-sync on so no Sync again — and its caption wraps to two lines at phone width, as the app's does. Demo data: the numbers of the 2026-09-24 screenshots (LL_PICPLACE=synced|syncing over jobs staged in the library's PicPlace/sync-state.json, iPhone 16 Pro simulator, iOS 27).
